    It's a concept (A8) of the future/end (H13) and words (B8).
    It's an action (H14) of words (B8) and a cycle (G14) and the end (H13).

    Could it be "Ageing"? (Not a celebration).
    "Coming of age"? (Celebration).
    "Milestone"? (Celebration).

    Let's try "First Birthday".
    "First" = F11 (One).
    "Birthday" = B10 (Celebration) + A10 (Date).
    "New" = C1.

    But what about the "Words" and "Future/End"?
    "Happy Birthday" is what you say.
    "Birthday Song" is what you sing.

    Is it "Birthday Party"? (No house/party).
